mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pet_face_embedding(pet_id, image_url, image_urls, image_count, model_version, embedding_dim, embedding_json, embedding_items_json) VALUES(#{petId}, #{imageUrl}, #{imageUrls}, #{imageCount}, #{modelVersion}, #{embeddingDim}, #{embeddingJson}, #{embeddingItemsJson}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE image_url = VALUES(image_url), image_urls = VALUES(image_urls), image_count = VALUES(image_count), model_version = VALUES(model_version), embedding_dim = VALUES(embedding_dim), embedding_json = VALUES(embedding_json), embedding_items_json = VALUES(embedding_items_json), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM pet_face_embedding WHERE pet_id = #{petId} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM pet_face_embedding ORDER BY updated_at DESC
